decisions.reason: As a low-cost, complementary upsell that was still carried beyond launch, premium support likely cleared a modest aspiration level and is worth keeping while results remain acceptable.

Because the version management tool remained prominently presented after launch and fits the firm's core web-service bundle, management would likely retain it unless later results clearly fell below aspiration.

The data-processing-contract tool looks more like a time-specific GDPR response with ongoing update needs, so if usage has flattened a medium-sized firm would likely reallocate resources once it falls short of aspiration.

Scalable hosting for agencies is strategically close to the established business and recurring-revenue oriented, so boundedly rational management would usually keep it unless there is clear evidence of underperformance.
